shared_instruction: Use the situation and the latest confirmed request to select one shelf product. Touch it with either gripper. A correct touch earns 1 point and ends the episode. Touching any other stocked product fails immediately at 0 points; simultaneous correct and wrong touches also fail. Do not pick up, carry, or place the product. Shelf/frame contact is not product selection.
